model_annotations.Bulgarian: Фигура 5 представя стълбовидна диаграма, която илюстрира точността (Accuracy, %) на различни методи за обучение с подсилване (RL) с и без самоотражение (self-reflection) върху три бенчмарка. Хоризонталната ос съдържа три категории бенчмарки, подредени отляво надясно: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като „Accuracy (%)" и обхваща диапазон приблизително от 30% до 42%, със стъпки, които изглеждат равномерно разпределени. Диаграмата съдържа групирани стълби, като за всяка категория бенчмарк са представени шест стълба, съответстващи на шест различни метода, обозначени в легендата в горната част на фигурата: DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, SRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, DAPO и PPO. Всеки метод е представен с различен цвят или шарка — DAPO+Self-reflection е показан в червено, GRPO в оранжево, SRPO в синьо, PPO+Self-reflection в розово, DAPO в жълто и PPO в сиво. За бенчмарка Mathverse стълбите достигат стойности приблизително в диапазона от около 34% до 42%, като DAPO+Self-reflection и SRPO изглеждат сред по-високите стълби. За MMLU стойностите варират приблизително между 34% и 39%. За Physics стойностите се разполагат приблизително между 33% и 40%. Подписът на фигурата указва, че тя показва представянето на различни RL методи с и без самоотражение. Стълбите в рамките на всяка група не изглеждат подредени по определен възходящ или низходящ ред, а следват последователността, зададена от легендата. Няма визуално подчертаване на конкретни стълби чрез засенчване, удебеляване или допълнителни бележки.
model_annotations.Chinese:
This bar chart presents the performance of various reinforcement learning (RL) methods with and without self-reflection, as indicated by the title and caption. The horizontal axis represents three benchmark categories labeled "Mathverse," "MMLU," and "Physics," arranged from left to right. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, with values ranging from approximately 30% to 42%, and gridlines appearing at intervals of roughly 2 percentage points (30, 32, 34, 36, 38, 40, 42).

For each of the three benchmarks, there are five grouped bars corresponding to five methods, distinguished by color and identified in the legend at the top of the chart: "DAPO+Self-reflection" in a reddish-pink color, "GRPO" in a blue color, "PPO+Self-reflection" in a yellow or gold color, "GRPO+Self-reflection" in a green color, and "PPO" in a gray color. The bars are arranged side by side within each group.

In the "Mathverse" group, the bars range from approximately 33% to around 37%, with DAPO+Self-reflection and GRPO+Self-reflection appearing among the taller bars and PPO appearing as one of the shorter bars. In the "MMLU" group, the bars cluster around approximately 35% to 38%, with relatively similar heights across methods. In the "Physics" group, the bars range from roughly 36% to approximately 42%, with DAPO+Self-reflection reaching the highest value near 42% and PPO appearing among the lower values around 37–38%.

The bars do not appear to follow a strict ordering such as alphabetical or descending within each group; rather, they maintain a consistent left-to-right arrangement matching the legend order across all three benchmark categories. No bars appear to be visually emphasized through bolding, outlining, or special annotation beyond the color coding used to distinguish the methods.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the performance (measured as accuracy percentage) of various reinforcement learning (RL) methods with and without self-reflection across three benchmark categories. The horizontal axis displays three category labels: "Mathverse," "MMLU," and "Physics," while the vertical axis represents "Accuracy (%)" with a scale ranging from approximately 30 to 65, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The chart contains grouped bars, with six methods represented in the legend: "DAPO+Self-reflection" (red), "GRPO" (dark blue or navy), "SRPO+Self-reflection" (pink/light red), "SRPO" (light blue), "PPO+Self-reflection" (orange), and "PPO" (gray or light color). For each of the three benchmark categories, a cluster of six bars is shown side by side. In the "Mathverse" group, the bars range from approximately 33–42%, with DAPO+Self-reflection appearing to be the tallest at roughly 42% and the base PPO method appearing among the shortest at around 33–34%. In the "MMLU" group, the bars cluster around 50–58%, with the self-reflection-enhanced variants generally appearing slightly taller than their non-self-reflection counterparts. In the "Physics" group, the bars range from approximately 48–63%, with DAPO+Self-reflection and SRPO appearing among the tallest at roughly 62–63%. Across all three benchmarks, the self-reflection variants (indicated by warmer colors such as red, pink, and orange) are visually positioned adjacent to their corresponding base methods (in cooler or more muted colors), facilitating visual comparison of each method with and without self-reflection. The bars do not appear to be sorted in any particular order beyond their grouping by method type, and no bars are visually emphasized through bolding or outlining beyond the color distinctions described.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm in Abbildung 5 zeigt die Leistung verschiedener RL-Methoden mit und ohne Self-Reflection, gemessen anhand der Accuracy (in Prozent) auf drei Benchmarks. Die horizontale Achse ist in drei Kategorien unterteilt: „Mathverse", „MMLU" und „Physics", während die vertikale Achse die Accuracy in Prozent darstellt, mit einer Skala, die von etwa 30 bis 42 reicht, wobei Tick-Markierungen bei 30, 32, 34, 36, 38, 40 und 42 sichtbar sind. Für jede der drei Benchmark-Kategorien sind fünf gruppierte Balken dargestellt, die jeweils einer Methode entsprechen, wie in der Legende oben im Diagramm angegeben: „DAPO+Self-reflection" (rot), „GRPO" (blau), „SRPO+Self-reflection" (rosa/pink), „SRPO" (orange) und „PPO" (grau). Bei „Mathverse" erreichen die Balken Werte von etwa 34 bis 38 Prozent, wobei „DAPO+Self-reflection" und „SRPO" die höchsten Werte von ungefähr 37–38 Prozent aufweisen, während „PPO" mit etwa 34 Prozent den niedrigsten Wert zeigt. Bei „MMLU" liegen die Werte insgesamt höher, im Bereich von etwa 38 bis 42 Prozent, wobei „DAPO+Self-reflection" mit ungefähr 42 Prozent den höchsten Balken aufweist und „PPO" mit etwa 38 Prozent den niedrigsten. Bei „Physics" bewegen sich die Werte zwischen etwa 34 und 40 Prozent, wobei „DAPO+Self-reflection" erneut mit circa 40 Prozent den höchsten Wert erreicht und „PPO" mit etwa 34 Prozent den niedrigsten Balken darstellt. Die Balken sind innerhalb jeder Gruppe nebeneinander angeordnet und farblich gemäß der Legende kodiert, wobei die Methoden mit Self-Reflection (DAPO+Self-reflection und SRPO+Self-reflection) in rötlichen Tönen und die Basismethoden in blau, orange und grau dargestellt sind. Es ist keine explizite Sortierung der Balken nach Wertgröße erkennbar; die Reihenfolge innerhalb jeder Gruppe folgt der Legendenanordnung.
